description: Figure 5 is a composite figure consisting of three sub-figures labeled (a), (b), and (c), representing different aspects of personalized preference analysis. Sub-figure (b), specifically titled "P6: Matching statistics," is a pie chart that displays the distribution of preference matching frequencies for Persona 6 across six distinct frequency tiers. The chart is divided into six slices, each representing a different tier, with approximate proportions of 27.2%, 22.4%, 13.8%, 13.3%, 10.4%, and 6.2% for tiers labeled 6, 2, 4, 3, 5, and an unlabeled tier, respectively. The slices are distinguished by different colors, and the chart includes numerical labels indicating both the percentage and count for each tier. The chart does not include a legend, but the labels provide clear information about each slice. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, with the largest slice (27.2%) corresponding to tier 6 and the smallest (6.2%) corresponding to the unlabeled tier.
